the non pesticidal measures can be effectively used for management of sucking pest complex of Okra.

the evaluation of the effect of non-pesticidal methods on population density of sucking pest complex in okra and the comparison with chemical control in kharif 2019.

, the non pesticidal measures are effective against sucking pest complex on Okra and these measures can be used for the management of sucking pests of okra.
